title: My neighbor's mini weiner dog puppy Mia
author: AZCoolRay
text: My neighbor’s mini weiner dog puppy Mia. Little fart is only 4 lbs lol. Cute as hell. They tried talking me in to getting her brother who’s the same color.
blurb: Meet Mia, a black-and-tan mini doxie puppy who weighs only 4 lbs and gazes up at the camera with enormous eyes and ears to match. The poster admits the neighbors nearly talked them into adopting her brother.
